contributions.original_prompts:
New raw `raw/stripe-payments-payment-intents-upgrade-to-handle-actions-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw `raw/stripe-migrate-basic-card-integration-2026.md`. Current summaries `wiki/sources/source-stripe-migrate-basic-card-integration.md`.

- Q1. For `https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-intents/upgrade-to-handle-actions`, what documented behavior, prerequisites, actors and state transitions does the complete new capture establish? How do these compare with the matched prior capture and each mapped summary?

- Q2. Which changes are substantive, presentational or navigation-only? Identify the exact dated qualifications, conflicts and reciprocal routes that the proposed disposition should preserve.

reviewed_answers.Q1: The November guide at https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-intents/upgrade-to-handle-actions upgrades an existing basic card integration from failing on bank authentication to handling it. The merchant server removes error_on_requires_action and creates/confirms with confirmation_method=manual. November's curl uses allowed_payment_method_types for card. For requires_action the customer authenticates in the Stripe.js handleCardAction modal using the Intent client secret. Successful action yields requires_confirmation and the merchant server re-confirms the same Intent; without confirmation within one hour the attempt fails back to requires_payment_method. Authentication alone does not establish payment success (new raw lines 18-52 and 54-91). The May guide documents the same flow with Node/Express, older payment_method_types and use_stripe_sdk in its full example (old raw lines 19-83 and 118-161). source-stripe-migrate-basic-card-integration.md retains the May flow and needs both date-scoped examples and conditions.
reviewed_answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-intents/upgrade-to-handle-actions, the substantive example change is allowed_payment_method_types replacing writable payment_method_types in the shown create request (old raw lines 26-35; new raw lines 27-36). Separate Dahlia and Endive references establish compatibility and API-version limits. Node-to-curl and screenshot changes are presentation, while the omission of full server branches and use_stripe_sdk changes the example's coverage without establishing removal (old raw lines 41-83 and 124-161; new raw lines 38-46 and 81-91). Keep the May and November one-hour manual re-confirmation boundary, the conditional SDK-use field and the sandbox fixture conflict in source-stripe-migrate-basic-card-integration.md. The test table repeats authentication_not_handled even though the guide adds action handling, and the bank controls live modal UI (old raw lines 163-171; new raw lines 93-101). Preserve the reciprocal Payment Intents concept and separate no-authentication guide routes.
